purpose: Systematically reconcile anomalous JBLR botanical genera against Flora vascular de La Rioja, the national pattern list, POWO/WCVP, WFO and ANTHOS, while detecting possible non-plant contamination.

local_flora_input.method: User supplies photograph(s) covering the genus entry.
local_flora_input.coverage_guard: Absence from one photograph is not absence from the local flora unless the supplied page set demonstrably covers the complete genus entry. For genera spanning several pages, all relevant pages are required before using absence as evidence.

comparison_layers.role: local Rioja occurrence/list evidence and rank as printed
exact taxon, kingdom, family, taxonomic group and Flora Iberica-linked national record

cross_kingdom_guard.rule: An exact name returned as non-Plantae by the national pattern list is a contamination candidate, not automatic proof of exclusion.
required_confirmation: no corresponding botanical taxon is supported by POWO/WCVP, WFO or ANTHOS under the exact name or demonstrated valid botanical synonym

downstream_invalidation.rule: Any taxon identity change, split, merge reversal, rank replacement, addition or botanical-universe removal invalidates inherited AMENAZA, PROTECCION and REPRESENTACION_EX_SITU conclusions for the changed identity.
downstream_invalidation.action: Fresh downstream execution is required; old outputs remain audit evidence only.

working_mode: Process anomalous genera one by one. After the user supplies the relevant Rioja flora page(s), reconcile the complete genus before moving to the next genus.
